summary: Every legal input is one fixed 3 by 3 binary-color grid, so the algorithm always checks exactly four candidate squares with a constant work bound.

workload_bound.source_constraint: grid always has exactly three rows and three columns

replacement_checks.evidence: Four possible 2 by 2 squares times four cells per square gives a fixed maximum of 16 cell inspections.
The certificate regression enumerates all 2^9 = 512 legal B/W grids and compares the reference with an independent square-count oracle.
